result.note: Weekly round-up; tested the India–China confidence-building steps before the BRICS summit and the domestic market-access measures. Speculative framing skipped.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about India–China engagement in the week before the BRICS summit hosted by India in September 2026:
items: India and China held their first-ever eastern-sector corps commander talks in Sikkim.
The summit marked Xi Jinping's first visit to India since 2019.
The Commerce Ministry canvassed Indian industry on Chinese curbs on rare-earth magnets and battery technology.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: The first-ever eastern-sector corps commander talks were held in Arunachal Pradesh, not Sikkim. The talks extended a thaw that began with Doval's Beijing trip, while the Commerce Ministry gathered grievances to raise face to face at the summit on 12 and 13 September.
questions.source: It held its first-ever eastern-sector corps commander talks with China in Arunachal Pradesh

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about measures taken by the Government of India in September 2026:
items: The government moved to charge satellite operators a spectrum levy described as one of the world's steepest.
The government squeezed 15 offshore crypto platforms.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Both steps were taken on Thursday, 10 September 2026, and e-commerce discount rules were tightened the next day. Together they reflected the government deciding what access to India's market should cost.
questions.source: The government moved to charge satellite operators one of the world's steepest spectrum levies on Thursday, squeezed 15 offshore crypto platforms the same day, and tightened e-commerce discount rules on Friday.
